MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 12

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 105
   D. 30

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

13. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

14. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

16. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 5

17. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 37
   C. 36
   D. 13

18. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

20. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 65

21. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 10

22. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

23. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 11

24. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

25. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

26. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

27. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

28. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

29. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

30. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 0
